**Method & caveats**

- **The screens ran on 2026-10-30, not today.** shibui's latest ingested bar at the 18:30 ET fire is 2026-10-30 (Friday), so every stylist screen is one session stale.
- The 2026-11-02 session close for all 496 candidates comes from the TradingView scanner, and it is the overlay column (`chg_1102`) that tells you which of Friday's setups survived today.
- **Today's overlay is what demotes most of the Tier-A list.** Nine of the eleven Tier-A names closed lower today;
- HTFL −7.7%, PURR −11.8%, ABCL −9.4%, QLYS −7.4%, CAI −6.5% are the day-2 fades of Friday's high-RS names. MTZ (+4.1%) and CDNA (−1.8%) are the only two that held up.
- **Every candidate carries a Friday close and a Monday close** — the two columns must not be mixed. The `close_1030`/`chg_1030` pair is the screen basis; `close_1102`/`chg_1102` is the settled overlay.
- The skill's shipped sweep SQL has five defects (missing comma, aliased-then-misnamed LAG columns, mismatched UNION arity, a 9-month window shorter than the 252-day LAG it needs, and inherited column names in a UNION ALL).
- All SQL was rebuilt with uniform, explicitly-named columns; the Qullamägi RS book now returns data instead of silently emptying.
- The skill's breadth SQL computes `atr_252d_avg` inside a CTE already filtered to a single date, so the partition holds one row and the "ATR extension" collapses to distance-from-50-DMA.
- The ATR multiples quoted here are recomputed over a real 252-session window.
- CANSLIM is rebuilt on shibui's `fundamentals_derived_quarterly` because TradingView's `earnings_growth_quarterly_yoy` / `sales_growth_quarterly_yoy` columns return null for every US name.
- The Hernandez funnel selects leaders, not whole sectors: top-3 themes → their GICS sectors → the top 5 by 3-month RS inside each sector that already cleared another stylist screen.
- Finviz and the `market-recap` bridge pack were both unavailable; no number in this artifact comes from either.
- TV closes were cross-checked against the CBOE CDN and matched to the cent on every sampled name.
- The 3:55 PM reversal-bullish scan and the Sunday IPO / high-short-float refreshes are **not** part of this routine (cron #04 and the Sunday weekly routine own them).
